title: Acetate Buffer Preparation
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfx9jpr6

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M acetic acid solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 5.8 mL glacial acetic acid with deionized water to a final volume of 1000 mL to obtain a 0.1 M acetic acid solution (for buffers with target pH 3.6–5.6).

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M sodium acetate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve either 8.2 g L⁻¹ anhydrous sodium acetate (MW = 82.0 g mol⁻¹) or 13.6 g L⁻¹ sodium acetate trihydrate (MW = 136.0 g mol⁻¹) in deionized water and bring the volume to 1000 mL to obtain a 0.1 M sodium acetate solution.

steps.title: Mix acid and acetate solutions
steps.instruction: Combine the 0.1 M acetic acid and 0.1 M sodium acetate solutions in the proportions indicated for the desired pH (3.6–5.6).

steps.title: Adjust volume to 100 mL
steps.instruction: Bring the mixture to a final volume of 100 mL with deionized water.

steps.title: Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Measure and adjust the pH to the target value (within 3.6–5.6) using a sensitive pH meter.
